scope: Six predeclared targeted primary-body retrieval routes, with directly identified links followed within a route; no repeated broad scouting.
web_records_are: Full tool request and available full returned text, not raw HTTP or hidden engine requests.
curl_records_are: Actual argv, clean environment, cwd, timestamps, exit, full stdout/stderr, available full headers/body and before/after inputs; HTTP errors are not silently converted to curl failures.

routes.name: Official publisher
routes.body_read_scope: All 834 header bytes and first 400 of 832805 body bytes inspected; all returned bytes retained. HTML document prefix and HTTP 403 are not a paper PDF. The rest of the denial HTML was not read as science.

routes.name: Official author pages
routes.body_read_scope: No response body; zero-byte header file. Complete error/progress stream and transport metadata read.
routes.web_read_scope: Full journal-page error and complete returned 23-line official LRT README; names paper and links MATLAB software. No downloaded or executed ZIP.

routes.name: Institution-restricted exact discovery
routes.web_read_scope: Complete combined empty search return. No deposit was located through this query; no repository absence theorem.

routes.name: Exact-DOI OA location metadata
routes.body_read_scope: All 8234 JSON bytes and all 1539 header bytes read. Metadata has one publisher-only location; pdf_url, oa_url and best_oa_location are null; has_content.pdf false. No primary-body URL to follow.

routes.name: Exact owner/title arXiv discovery
routes.web_read_scope: Complete combined empty search return. No arXiv body or theorem read; no global nonexistence claim.

routes.name: One exact-title PDF-location search
routes.query: "Local rank transform: Properties and applications" filetype:pdf
routes.body_read_scope: Exact DBLP GET returned no body and zero header bytes; complete error/progress stream and metadata read.
routes.web_read_scope: Full available search response read: publisher preview, secondary/request-only records and citing works. Publisher preview covers abstract, section extracts including partial Definition 2.1 and conclusion, not the convergence theorem. Exact discovered DBLP record open returned a complete one-line error. Adjacent unpaywalled label not attributed to target. No full-text request or author contact sent.

retrieval_time_http_status_note: Original HTTP_RESULT full_text_status stays UNASSESSED_UNTIL_BODY_READ. This final ledger provides the later actual read classifications without altering historical raw receipts.

other_read_scopes.local_originals: All selected instruction and scientific prose originals read completely; old source XML read fully. Historical SHA lists inspected as attribution only. No author verifier read, imported or executed.
other_read_scopes.tc_sd_summed_fibre_admission_comparison: Conditional on obtaining body; not performed or cleared. Known literal disjoint-union obligation is retained.

stop_rule: Six-route cap reached. Preserve LNR-S1 OPEN / HOLD_SOURCE / NO_ADMISSION; no seventh retrieval route.
